🇬🇧🚀 Britain pledges more than 1,000 air defense missiles for Ukraine
The UK has announced a new military aid package for Ukraine worth approximately $316 million. It includes over 1,000 short-range air defense missiles, launchers and more than a dozen radars.
According to the British government's announcement, deliveries to the Ukrainian Armed Forces are expected to begin in mid-December. The package builds on the 400 surface-to-air missiles the UK already supplied to Ukraine ahead of winter. The missiles are intended to help counter Russia's jet-powered Geran drones.
Media reports suggest that the weapons in question are Thales Lightweight Multirole Missiles (LMMs), also known as Martlet. Although 1,000 missiles may sound like a substantial number, the stockpile could prove relatively modest given the scale of Russia's drone campaign. Moreover, not every engagement requires just one missile.
Russia launched approximately 1,500 jet-powered drones in July 2026 and more than 2,500 in August, according to Ukraine's Ministry of Defense.

🚀 IRGC downs another US Predator drone near Iran's Qeshm
The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has shot down another US-made General Atomics MQ-1 Predator drone near Qeshm Island, bringing the number of such aircraft destroyed by Iran to 18, Tasnim News Agency reports.
The MQ-1 Predator is primarily used for intelligence gathering but can also engage targets. According to the IRGC Aerospace Force, its air defense units intercepted and destroyed the drone at 13:45 local time using a new, advanced air defense system.
Meanwhile, the reported number of US-made MQM-170 drones shot down or seized by Iran has risen to nine.
US and Iranian figures for downed American drones differ. However, the Pentagon has acknowledged losing dozens of UAVs, while CNN reported in October that the US had lost at least 81 military aircraft worth up to $3.3 billion.
